name: report-quality-set-v1
how_chosen: By hand from live clusters investigated in the 10 hours before, to cover every cluster kind, both platforms (Bluesky, Mastodon), images and video, languages outside the model card's list (ru, th, es), documented propaganda servers, spam, and organic controls. Fixed: every prompt or pipeline version is run on the same clusters, close in time, before the 72-hour deletion of their posts.
